title: risk.alert_raised
description: An alert for the traders (BO-09; C08 §9). Published by the betting module on NATS subject evt.risk.alert_raised (version 1), written to the outbox in the transaction of the bet that raised it. kind large_bet: a bet whose stake is at or above the tenant's risk.large_bet_alert. Consumers: C15 (the large-bet feed, B10), C14 later. Amounts in santim; ids only, no personal data. This is the `data` payload; the envelope (event_id, type, version, tenant_id, occurred_at, trace_id) is TD-02 §5. New fields and kinds are additive only.

stake_santim.description: The stake charged: at or above threshold_santim

threshold_santim.description: The tenant's risk.large_bet_alert when the bet was placed
